payload.summary: Tests for canonically equivalent filesystem names must account for locale comparator ties and actual directory order.
lessons: When validation reports whichever canonically equivalent directory appears second, do not hardcode one Unicode spelling as the collision path.

If production sorts directory entries with localeCompare, compute expected collision paths from the actual sorted directory names because localeCompare can return 0 for canonically equivalent strings.
Avoid deriving expected paths from validation errors; derive them from filesystem setup and the same documented ordering rule instead.
verification: Run focused records validation tests on the branch after resolving review feedback about Unicode or case-collision path ordering.
